taxa.taxonomy_note: Lemon basil should be recorded as Ocimum × africanum Lour. rather than O. basilicum. Its ids were verified separately and are listed under synonyms. NCBI taxid read from the NCBI Taxonomy checklist that GBIF mirrors (dataset fab88965-e69d-4491-a04d-e3198b626e52), because the NCBI pages could not be reached directly (browser rate-limited, E-utilities blocked by robots.txt). WFO id is null because worldfloraonline.org could not be fetched (TLS/robots failure). 'Mrs Burns' Lemon' is often treated as the hybrid O. × africanum (NCBI 204098, POWO 452853-1, GBIF 3898584); kept under O. basilicum pending confirmation.

pregnancy_lactation.statement: EMA advises minimising exposure of pregnant and breastfeeding women to methyleugenol, and does not recommend estragole intake above its guidance value in pregnancy and lactation; these statements concern herbal medicinal products, not culinary use.
pregnancy_lactation.md: [EMA](#term:ema-hmpc) advises minimising exposure of pregnant and breastfeeding women to [methyleugenol](#term:methyleugenol), and does not recommend [estragole](#term:estragole) intake above its [guidance value](#term:guidance-value) in pregnancy and lactation; these statements concern herbal medicinal products, not culinary use.
